params.prompt: Full-body front-view color character illustration based on the attached reference photos of the real Korean MMA fighter Baek Seung-min, stylized as a grounded anime character while keeping his real face, hair and build recognizable. He stands relaxed but perfectly balanced with his weight even on both feet, arms hanging loosely at his sides, hands half open, chin level, an easygoing, good-natured face with a faint playful smirk and a closed mouth. He is a 40-year-old Korean man, a former ROAD FC featherweight boxer-style striker who now runs and coaches at an MMA gym: 183 cm and about 70 kg, about 7.6 heads tall with realistic proportions, a tall, long-limbed, lean but strong build with long arms and legs, wide square shoulders, a narrow waist, a long neck, clearly defined wiry muscle on the shoulders, chest and forearms, not bulky. Light warm skin. A long narrow face with high defined cheekbones, a sharp angular jaw and a narrow chin, narrow single-lidded eyes, thin straight black eyebrows, a straight nose, thin lips, a faint thin mustache and a light small chin beard. Short black hair: the sides and back are cut short in a fade, the top is longer and slicked straight back from the forehead. Outfit: a plain muted slate-teal short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#456462), plain charcoal-black jogger training pants (#2E2E31) with cuffed ankles, white crew socks (#F0EBE2), black rubber slides (#2A2A2C). Plain unbranded clothing. Colors: light warm skin with mauve shadows, black hair, the slate-teal t-shirt as the main tone and the charcoal pants; no orange anywhere. Plain warm off-white paper background (#F4EFE6) with a soft grounding shadow under the feet, whole body visible from hair to soles. Muted cinematic anime cel shading, like a still from a grounded theatrical anime film: flat colors with one crisp shadow tone (a second darker tone only under the chin and beneath the brow), skin shadows in soft mauve-brown, shadows on white cloth in cool blue-grey, soft pink flush on cheeks, nose tip, ears and knuckles. Bold, slightly rough warm near-black outlines (#1A1417), thick on the silhouette and thin inside. Low-to-medium saturation, no gradients on the character, no glossy highlights, no rim-light glow, no eye sparkle, very subtle paper grain. Avoid: a tongue sticking out, an open mouth, hand gestures, shirtless, fight shorts, big shiny anime eyes, eye highlights, spiky anime hair, glossy skin, elongated 8-9-head fashion proportions, bodybuilder muscles, tattoos, scars, bandages, gloves on the hands, bracelets, glasses, a championship belt, cigarettes, smoking, alcohol, brand logos, any readable text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or signatures.
